title: Translation catalogue, version 1
description: One file per language (part D §14.2.1). Entries are keyed by (scope, id, source): the same id with a different source string is a different entry. Plural categories live here, for the translator, and never reach the feed: the generator resolves them to one finished string per language (part D §14.2.2, annex §8.1). Catalogue files are untrusted input to the generator. SPDX-License-Identifier: Apache-2.0.

scope.description: element: id is the element UUID. category, rule, library: things without an element UUID that are translatable too.

source.description: The source-language string this translation was made from. Part of the key.

previousSource.description: The source string before an upstream rename. Lets the generator re-key the translation instead of orphaning it; a re-keyed entry is 'needs-review' (part D §5).

plural.description: A translation whose form depends on a count fixed by the element (a three-pole contactor has three poles in every language). The generator selects the CLDR plural category of 'count' for this catalogue's language and substitutes '#' with the count. 'other' is always required.
